cases.summary: Verify default language on cold start is French
cases.expected: Splash screen displays in French; language switcher shows French and English
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-001, REQ-002; Splash on launch, default language French

cases.summary: Verify user can switch splash language to English
cases.expected: UI copy updates to English without requiring login
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-003; User can switch French and English

cases.summary: Verify Senegal MSISDN accepts prefix 7 and 9 digits
cases.input: Enter valid agent MSISDN e.g. 70 000 01 01 (9 digits, prefix 7)
cases.expected: 9-digit prefix-7 MSISDN is accepted and validation continues. The user does not type +221. Comment on SAA-908: keep +221 static on the FE.
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006; Prefix 7, 9 digits; +221 static on FE per comment

cases.summary: Verify last-used MSISDN auto-fills on subsequent login
cases.preconditions: User logged out after prior successful login on same device
cases.expected: Previously used MSISDN pre-filled; field remains editable
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-007; Last used MSISDN auto-filled

cases.summary: Verify user can edit auto-filled MSISDN
cases.input: Clear and enter different valid agent MSISDN
cases.expected: New MSISDN used for Get User Detail validation
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-008; User can edit auto-filled MSISDN

cases.summary: Verify Agent or Staff grade proceeds to OTP
cases.preconditions: Staging; valid agent MSISDN; Grade Name Agent or Staff
cases.expected: API success; OTP verification screen displayed
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-009, REQ-010; Grade Agent or Staff proceeds to OTP

cases.summary: Verify non Agent/Staff MSISDN shows exact block message
cases.preconditions: MSISDN returns Grade Name not Agent/Staff
cases.expected: Error displayed unchanged: "The phone number entered is not allowed to connect to the YAS Agent App. Please try again with a correct number."
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-011; Non Agent/Staff exact error quote

cases.summary: Verify OTP screen shown after successful MSISDN validation
cases.expected: OTP entry screen with resend control (disabled until expiry per story)
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-012, REQ-013; OTP screen after MSISDN validation

cases.summary: Verify invalid OTP shows exact error text
cases.expected: Error unchanged: "Invalid OTP. The code you entered is incorrect. Please check the OTP and try again."
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-014; Invalid OTP exact error quote

cases.summary: Verify resend OTP available after OTP expiry
cases.expected: New OTP requested; resend enabled only after expiry
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-013; Resend OTP after expiry. Duration not stated in the story

cases.summary: Verify Privacy, Camera and Image access must be accepted before continue
cases.input: Attempt Confirm and Continue without accepting all three
cases.expected: Continue blocked until Privacy terms, Camera access and Image access accepted
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-015; Privacy, camera, and image access required

cases.summary: Verify Confirm and Continue enabled when all consents accepted
cases.input: Accept all three consents; tap Confirm and Continue
cases.expected: User proceeds to PIN verification
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-016; Confirm and Continue only after all consents

cases.summary: Verify wrong PIN 1st attempt message
cases.preconditions: PIN screen; Check PIN API returns invalid
cases.expected: Message: "PIN entered is incorrect. Please try again."
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-018, REQ-020; Wrong PIN attempt 1

cases.summary: Verify wrong PIN 2nd attempt message
cases.expected: Same message: "PIN entered is incorrect. Please try again."
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-018, REQ-020; Wrong PIN attempt 2

cases.summary: Verify 3rd wrong PIN triggers lock message with wait period
cases.expected: Message includes: "You have entered the wrong password multiple times. Your account is temporarily locked. Please wait X minute before trying again."; Retry disabled until lock expires
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-019, REQ-020; 3rd wrong PIN lock message. Initial minutes shown as X

cases.summary: Verify lock duration increases by 1 minute after each set of 3 failures
cases.preconditions: Complete two sets of 3 failed PIN attempts (BO/config as per story)
cases.input: Observe lock timer after 3rd and 6th failure
cases.expected: Second lock wait is 1 minute longer than first (per story rule)
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-021; Lock time increases by 1 minute after each set of 3 failures

cases.summary: Verify Check PIN API success completes login
cases.expected: Login succeeds; user reaches post-login flow (biometric on first login)
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-017, REQ-028; Check PIN success; biometric on first login

cases.summary: Verify PIN reset request available from PIN screen
cases.expected: PIN reset flow starts per product design
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-023; Description says PIN reset from PIN screen. Comments say password reset is out of mobile scope

cases.summary: Verify second device login terminates first session with exact message
cases.preconditions: Connected Device=1 in BO; user logged in on Device A
cases.input: Login same MSISDN on Device B with OTP
cases.expected: Device A shows: "You have been logged out of your current session because your account was accessed using your credentials on another device."; Device B continues after OTP
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-024; Second device terminates the first session with the quoted message

cases.summary: Verify new device requires OTP and becomes linked MSISDN device
cases.expected: OTP required; new device linked; session active on new device only
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-025; New device requires OTP and becomes the linked device

cases.summary: Verify allowed connected device count configurable in Back Office
cases.input: Change connected device limit; retry two-device scenario
cases.expected: App behaviour matches BO setting for concurrent sessions
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-026; Connected-device count is managed in Back Office. No Back Office steps in the story

cases.summary: Verify new MSISDN prefixes can be added via Back Office
cases.input: Add prefix; login with MSISDN under new prefix
cases.expected: Validation accepts MSISDN per updated BO prefix rules
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-027; New prefixes can be added in Back Office. No Back Office steps in the story

cases.summary: Verify biometric enrolment mandatory on first successful login in Senegal
cases.expected: Biometric setup screen mandatory; no skip path for Senegal
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-028; Biometric setup mandatory; Senegal cannot skip

cases.summary: Verify fingerprint OR face recognition enrolment path
cases.input: Complete enrolment via fingerprint or face
cases.expected: Fingerprint or face enrolment can be completed. The story does not name the screen after enrolment.
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-029; Fingerprint or face recognition

cases.summary: Verify biometrics can be disabled later from Profile Settings
cases.expected: Biometrics can be disabled from Profile Settings.
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-030; Disable biometrics from Profile Settings

cases.summary: Verify invalid MSISDN format blocked before API
cases.input: Enter MSISDN not matching SN rules (not 9 digits / not prefix 7)
cases.expected: An MSISDN that is not 9 digits with prefix 7 is not accepted.
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-005; MSISDN must be prefix 7 and 9 digits

cases.summary: Verify full happy-path login Agent on staging
cases.input: Splash → MSISDN → OTP → Terms → PIN → biometric (if first login)
cases.expected: MSISDN, OTP, the three consents, and PIN succeed. On first login, biometric setup is shown and cannot be skipped.
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-004, REQ-010, REQ-012, REQ-016, REQ-017, REQ-028; Happy path

cases.summary: Verify quoted login errors identical in EN UI when story strings are English
cases.input: Trigger invalid user and invalid OTP errors
cases.expected: English error strings match story quotes exactly
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-011, REQ-014; Quoted English error strings

cases.summary: Verify OTP resend not available before expiry timer
cases.expected: Resend disabled until expiry
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-013; Resend is available after expiry, so it is not available before

cases.summary: Verify retry PIN enabled after lock period expires
cases.input: Wait full lock duration X minutes
cases.expected: Retry/login PIN input enabled again
cases.traceability: SAA-908; REQ-022; Retry enabled only after the lock period expires
